title: RoPE & Modern Positional Encoding
interviewAnswer: RoPE rotates query/key feature pairs according to token position so relative position affects attention scores without simply adding a fixed position vector.
why: Many modern LLMs use rotary or related positional mechanisms.
intuition: Position changes the orientation of Q/K vectors, so dot products encode relative offsets.
deepDive: RoPE applies frequency-dependent rotations; context-extension tricks rescale frequencies but can change quality.
commonMistakes: Saying RoPE is one-hot absolute position.
Assuming arbitrary context extension is free.
production: Benchmark long-context quality as well as maximum length and memory.
workedExample: Identical tokens at different positions interact differently because their Q/K rotations differ.
